description_en: Queries the security group that is associated with an endpoint
description_zh: 调用ListVpcEndpointSecurityGroups接口，查询终端节点已加入的安全组
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink list-vpc-endpoint-security-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --max-results 50 --endpoint-id ep-hp33b2e43fays7s80000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListVpcEndpointSecurityGroups

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoint that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的终端节点所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

If this is your first request and no next requests are to be performed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

If a next request is to be performed, set the parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:1 to 50. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，取值范围：1~50，默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint that you want to query
parameters.name: endpoint_id

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

NextToken.description_en:
The returned value of NextToken is a pagination token, which can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

If no value is returned for NextToken, no next requests are performed.

If a value is returned for NextToken, the value can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

SecurityGroups.description_en: The information about the security groups

items.description_en: The information about the array object

SecurityGroupId.description_en: The ID of the security group that is associated with the endpoint
SecurityGroupId.description_zh: 终端节点已加入的安全组ID

SecurityGroupStatus.description_en:
The associate status of the security group, valid values:

Attaching: The security group is being attached.

Attached: The security group is attached.

Detaching: The security group is being detached
SecurityGroupStatus.description_zh:
安全组关联状态，取值：
Attaching：关联中。
Attached：已关联。
Detaching：分离中

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
